problem_summary: Reconstruct a 3D density map from 2D noisy random-orientation cryoEM projections. Recover per-particle poses, declare handedness and symmetry.

forward_model.projection_convention: parallel projection along +Z after rotation by ZYZ Euler angles (alpha, beta, gamma) in degrees
forward_model.translation_convention: translation in Angstrom, converted to pixels by dividing by pixel_size_ang; rlnOriginXAngst is along column axis (x), rlnOriginYAngst along row axis (y)

pose_file_format.particle_ordering: row i corresponds to particles[i] in public_micrographs.npz

outputs_required.answer.json: structured metadata with declared symmetry, handedness, method, box, pixel size
outputs_required.reconstruction.mrc: 3D density map, MRC float32, box_size_px cubed
outputs_required.poses.star: RELION STAR file with rlnAngleRot/Tilt/Psi + rlnOriginXAngst/YAngst

reference_files.public_micrographs.npz: 500 noisy CTF-modulated projections + true poses/defoci at agent-visible SNR
reference_files.initial_model.mrc: low-resolution (~25A) featureless spherical starting model at correct box/pixel size
